targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '5m'), percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS "p50", percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS "p90"
FROM agent_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND latency_ms > 0
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '15m'), AVG((voice->'latencyStages'->>'asr_final')::numeric) AS "asr_final"
FROM agent_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND voice ? 'latencyStages'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '15m'), AVG((voice->'latencyStages'->>'turn_decided')::numeric) AS "turn_decided"
FROM agent_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND voice ? 'latencyStages'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '15m'), AVG((voice->'latencyStages'->>'tts_synthesized')::numeric) AS "tts_synthesized"
FROM agent_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND voice ? 'latencyStages'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '15m'), AVG((voice->'latencyStages'->>'audio_delivered')::numeric) AS "audio_delivered"
FROM agent_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND voice ? 'latencyStages'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 延迟分段均值（非堆积：各段为累计口径，tts_synthesized 为合成段耗时）

targets.rawSql:
WITH signals AS (
  SELECT playback_state AS state FROM interaction_ledger WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND playback_state IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT state FROM delivery_ledger WHERE $__timeFilter(updated_at)
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN state = 'interrupted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) AS "打断占比"
FROM signals

panels.title: 播放期打断率（interaction_ledger playback_state + delivery_ledger）

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'backchannel' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "微反应发出",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM match_events WHERE event_type IN ('big_chance','miss','save','var_check') AND $__timeFilter(created_at)) AS "白名单事件"
FROM interaction_ledger
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: 微反应发出 vs 白名单事件 24h（拒绝路径无痕，不承诺限频归因）

targets.rawSql:
SELECT state, COUNT(*) AS "条数"
FROM delivery_ledger
WHERE $__timeFilter(updated_at)
GROUP BY state ORDER BY "条数" DESC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'delivered' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) AS "送达率"
FROM proactive_reminders
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
  -- 分母含全部状态：delivered / suppressed / missed（missed = status 非
  -- delivered 且 expire_at 已过，表无 expired 状态值，migration 045）
